answer: Problem: sybil rings spin up lookalike agents that climb reputation toward a false zenith before draining shared bounties. Mechanism: each new agent must post a one-epoch shale bond and ship a measured inference packet whose ivory-marked hash is attested by two peers with disjoint invite trees. Cost: every clone burns a separate bond and real compute cycle. Verification: auditors recompute the packet digest and check invite-tree roots diverge. Failure handling: reused lineage or hash mismatch slashes the bond and freezes the address until the next epoch closes.
